paper.title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
paper.central_claim: TextGrad backpropagates LLM-generated textual feedback through computation graphs of text variables to optimise components of compound AI systems (code, solutions, prompts, molecules, treatment plans) with one general framework, improving each over its baselines.

evidence.quote:
Value
is the unstructured data that the variable contains. Throughout this manuscript, all values are text data.

2.

Role description
is an informative string that describes the role of the variable in the computation graph. We use these roles to let the user inject knowledge into the graph and guide the optimization behavior. More information is described below.

3.

Gradients
are the natural language feedback provided by the LLMs during the backward pass. These describe the changes to make the variable so that the downstream loss can be improved. For an example backward operation that populates gradients, please read Section
A.3
.

4.

Predecessors
are the set of variables that are used to generate a given variable. For instance, if we are giving an instruction to an LLM and getting a response, the instruction would be the predecessor of the response. During the backward pass, the gradients on the successor are passed to its predecessors, to provide guidance around how to improve the downstream objective.
evidence.support_explanation: 文本值、role、自然语言反馈、predecessors 构成统一图；后继反馈传播到前驱。

Reflexion is run with a
one shot prompt
that is meant to instruct the model on how to provide feedback. The pipeline run by Reflexion is as follows: given in input a prompt to generate code, a language model generates a first solution. If this solution passes the local tests, it is then submitted to the LeetCode platform to be evaluated on harder tests. However, if the solution does not pass the tests, we ask for feedback through Reflexion and optimize the code. Once again, if the new solution passes the local tests, we submit it to the LeetCode platform. We do this optimization for 5 iterations.

We ran the experiment 5 times with 5 different seeds and we averaged the results. At each iteration of optimization,

makes 1 call to
gpt-4o
to evaluate the test time loss, 1 call to collect gradients, and 1 call to update the code snippet. The number of coding problems in LeetCodeHard is 39.

evidence.quote:
is used to optimize the hyperparameters (e.g., importance weights for PTV and OARs) of the inner-loop numerical optimizer that generates the treatment plan. This optimization is done using a variation of vanilla
TextGrad
, i.e. “projected gradient descent with momentum updates”.In particular, three prostate cancer treatment plans optimized by clinicians, along with their corresponding hyperparameters, are provided. These examples guide the updates of the hyperparameters. This procedure can be viewed as an analogy to projection, as the updated hyperparameters are “softly projected” onto a feasible set defined by the three in-context examples. Moreover, the historical hyperparameters and the textual gradients from past iterations, as an analogy to momentum, are also included in the prompts for updating the hyperparameters. This additional context helps refine the optimization process. The optimization will be stopped if the loss suggests all protocols meet, other wise, it will be stopped if the maximum number of iterations (we set it to 10) is reached.

signatures.information: 变量值/角色、前向输入输出、后继节点反馈、用户目标/格式约束；strong LLM作为critic/updater
signatures.operation: 前向执行→损失/反馈→反拓扑遍历，将后继反馈连同上下文交LLM生成前驱批评→聚合文字梯度→TGD返回改写变量
signatures.output: 新文本变量；框架可统一接代码测试、LLM评价与数值仿真
signatures.conditions: LLM能理解局部组件、角色/目标与多项约束；文本批评非解析导数，无保证改善
signatures.feedback: 自然语言批评；可从执行测试/外部数值代理产生
signatures.selection_rule: TGD本身直接替换值，不提供跨应用统一保留认证；具体应用另加验证门
signatures.selection_data: 各应用特定数据/局部测试/仿真结果
signatures.persistence: 变量值被更新；是否跨输入保留取决于应用（S2才直接确证harness复用）
signatures.later_use: 更新值用于下一次前向；实例优化只继续同一问题
signatures.claimed_effect: 无需为每任务重写优化器即可优化异构变量
signatures.failure_boundary: 语义信用错配、深链反馈退化、模型能力与token边界；无数学链式法则/收敛保证

signatures.information: batch3个带标注训练问题、模型输出、gpt4o反馈；validation用于接受门
signatures.operation: 从CoT提示启动→12轮小批量文本反馈和改写→每轮验证，仅更好则提交；固定prompt用于后续test
signatures.output: 一个跨查询复用的优化prompt，不是针对每test题重写
signatures.conditions: validation有代表性；训练/选择与最终测试隔离；强反馈模型可提供可用建议
signatures.feedback: 训练任务表现/对真值的差异→文字批评；validation准确率
signatures.selection_data: BBH train50、validation100；GSM train200、validation300；36次抽样可重复
signatures.persistence: 同一Prompt变量/优化后system instruction保留
signatures.later_use: BBH test100及GSM test1319推理，不用其标签作更新信号
signatures.claimed_effect: 指令优化改善冻结forward LM在后续查询上的正确率
signatures.failure_boundary: 验证反复选择偏差/预训练污染未审计；主prompt实验无搜索种子方差；更强critic和不等总预算限制归因

signatures.object: System prompt of a weaker executor LLM (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125); baseline: zero-shot CoT prompt and DSPy BFSR demonstrations
signatures.information: Per-example conversation (system prompt, input, output) and an evaluation signal against ground truth; gpt-4o as backward engine; 36 sampled training examples
signatures.operation: Forward minibatch (3 examples) -> loss per example -> backward: LLM critique of the prompt in context -> TGD step rewrites the prompt; accept only if validation improves
signatures.conditions: Labels available at train time; stronger feedback model
signatures.feedback: Ground-truth correctness (string match or gpt-4o judge)
signatures.selection_rule/data: Validation improvement gate per iteration; 50/100/100 BBH and 200/300/1319 GSM8K splits
signatures.claimed_effect: Prompt optimisation matches DSPy on 2 of 3 tasks and exceeds it on Object Counting; all exceed zero-shot CoT
signatures.failure_boundary: No component ablation; noisy critiques; no rollback beyond the validation gate

signatures.object: Single-instance variables (code, solutions, SMILES, radiotherapy hyperparameters) - test-time refinement per input
signatures.information: Evaluator output, unit tests, docking simulator, matRad plans
signatures.operation: Iterate critique-and-rewrite on the instance for a few steps; majority vote for QA
signatures.claimed_effect: LeetCode-Hard 0.36 vs Reflexion 0.31; GPQA 55%; molecules; treatment plans

gap.author_gap: Compound AI systems are hand-tuned; there is no general automatic optimiser analogous to backprop for them.
gap.checked_gap: Real gap; nearest prompt optimisers (DSPy, ProTeGi) are distinguished mainly by graph propagation and instance optimisation, the former never isolated experimentally.
gap.method_response: Text variables with roles, per-edge LLM critiques routed backward, TGD update, validation-gated prompt retention.
gap.remaining_gap: Isolation of graph propagation; budget-matched comparisons; uncertainty of retained-prompt gains.

rs_pattern.reason: Primary: heterogeneous artifacts serialised into one text-variable substrate so the autograd/optimizer recipe transfers (C18). Supporting: optimisation recast as backprop by analogy; LLM critique manufactured as the adaptation signal.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: substrate manufactured (text values/roles/graph) met; recipe transfer partial (no equivalence); interface ablation unmet; breadth partial.
matches.success_failure_checks: uniform interface met; stronger-backbone explanation unresolved

matches.tactic_steps_checked: recast as computation graph + backward + step; reduction is an analogy
matches.success_failure_checks: RE-1 unmet, RE-3 partial, RE-4 unmet

matches.tactic_steps_checked: model critique as signal; instance loss self-supervised; prompt branch uses labels

matches.condition_checks: Prompt branch: single system prompt rewritten from per-example critiques; validation gate met; held-out split met; localised edit partial (whole-prompt rewrite).
Framework defines propagation through a graph, but no experiment optimises interacting variables; S1 partial, S3 partial, S5 met, F4 partial, F5 unmet, H09-step5 partial.

unassigned: Per-instance refinement (code, solutions, molecules, plans) carries no retained change and is outside the retained-harness evidence.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Text-variable substrate lets a critique be routed to the system prompt, which is rewritten and retained if validation improves.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Only the single-prompt case is evidenced; multi-variable propagation (H09) is a framework claim.

expectations.reason: 有多应用及DSPy/Reflexion对照；缺同信息同预算朴素critic、去图路由对照。
跨代码/QA/prompt/分子/计划，但主要critic仅gpt4o、科学结果代理、复杂真实图验证弱。

expectations.reason: 任务分有直接测量，但没有反馈归因正确率；局部提示例还显示语义漂移。
Analogy to backpropagation is explicit as a metaphor; no equivalence or guarantee.
Graph/variable/optimizer abstractions are new packaging of critique-and-rewrite; gains over ProTeGi-style single critique are untested.
No test that propagated critiques localise to the responsible variable.

expectations.applies_when: attribute gains to the manufactured signal
expectations.reason: No ablation of backward feedback vs random edits, nor of momentum/batching/constraints.
Calls per iteration are stated; no totals or comparison with baselines.

prompt用validation提升门，TGD API本身直接替换、不是普适认证。
Full conversation (system prompt, input, output) and objective are provided to the backward engine.

expectations.applies_when: feedback assumed to isolate the edited artifact
expectations.reason: Critiques on the prompt are not checked for whether the failure was caused by the prompt.

expectations.applies_when: 需将评价从批评/候选选择隔离

expectations.reason: Held-out test and alternative optimiser (DSPy) reported; teacher models differ and no same-budget comparison.

expectations.applies_when: 比较强critic/搜索优化器与基线的成本效益
expectations.reason: 披露逐边梯度调用及代码3calls×5迭代，但没等token/墙钟比较或失败候选/验证全账。

expectations.applies_when: 声称科学应用优化有效
expectations.reason: 剂量/Vina/QED仅支持in silico；D95部分由约束强制，实验/临床验证不在范围。
Prompt optimisation has no seeds or intervals; only LeetCode reports five seeds.
expectations.opus_note: Merged statistics check (sol-3 ≡ son55-2); status from son55.

expectations.applies_when: comparing prompt optimisers with different feedback models
expectations.reason: TextGrad uses gpt-4o as backward/update engine while the DSPy baseline is not stated to use a gpt-4o teacher; number of LM calls differs.

expectations.applies_when: abstract and tables report the same quantities
expectations.reason: LeetCode zero-shot differs between text (23%) and table (0.26); 20% relative gain not reproduced by 0.36 vs 0.31.
SOTA-type claims rest on voting-based test-time compute (GPQA), a re-extracted 39-problem dataset and in silico metrics optimised directly.

claims.text: Prompt optimisation with TextGrad improves gpt-3.5-turbo reasoning over zero-shot CoT and matches or beats DSPy.
claims.setting: Object Counting, Word Sorting (BBH 50/100/100), GSM8K (200/300/1319); gpt-3.5 executor, gpt-4o feedback
claims.baseline/control: zero-shot CoT; DSPy BFSR (10 candidates, 8 demos)
claims.selection_vs_test: validation gate per iteration; test reported
claims.result/denominator: tie on Word Sorting and GSM8K, +7 pp on Object Counting (n=100)
claims.allowed_conclusion: A gpt-4o-guided prompt rewrite loop raised held-out accuracy over zero-shot on three tasks; superiority over DSPy is not established.

claims.text: TextGrad is a general framework for optimising compound AI systems by backpropagating text through graphs.
claims.result/denominator: no multi-variable graph optimisation result; results are single-variable
claims.allowed_conclusion: Demonstrated as a library of single-variable critique-rewrite loops; graph propagation benefit untested.

claims.text: Instance optimisation improves coding (LeetCode-Hard 0.36), QA (GPQA 55%), molecules and treatment plans.
claims.baseline/control: Reflexion, CoT, best reported, clinical plans
claims.result/denominator: 39 problems x 5 seeds; GPQA 198; MMLU subsets 112/92; 5 patients
claims.allowed_conclusion: Task-level test-time gains with extra compute; outside the retained-component scope.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Only the prompt-optimisation branch retains a change: validation-gated system prompt evaluated on separate test splits; instance optimisation is task-level.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A gpt-4o-driven textual-gradient rewrite of gpt-3.5-turbo's system prompt, accepted only on validation improvement, beat zero-shot CoT on held-out BBH Object Counting / Word Sorting / GSM8K tests and tied or exceeded DSPy BFSR (author-reported single runs, 100-example BBH tests); per-input refinement results are task-level only.

G.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Concrete gap (hand-tuned compound AI systems lack a general optimiser) with DSPy/ProTeGi lineage named and distinguished; ProTeGi/OPRO not compared head-to-head, and the claimed advance is largely instance optimisation outside retained-harness scope.

M.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Graph of text variables with roles, per-edge LLM critiques routed to predecessors and TGD updates is reconstructable and the prompt branch adds a validation gate; the backprop analogy is metaphorical and credit assignment relies on a strong critic, with no prediction that distinguishes graph propagation from a single critique.

X.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Algorithm, backward/optimizer prompts, batching (3×12), momentum/constraints and the validation gate are given; no unified rollback, no multi-variable graph experiment, unclear reported iterate for instance tasks.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2; verified. Exact match and hidden platform tests are objective, but Word Sorting is judged by gpt-4o (feedback-engine family), the LeetCode zero-shot value disagrees between text (23%) and table (0.26) (opus:O01), and scientific results are in-silico proxies optimised directly.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; verified. Zero-shot CoT start and DSPy BFSR are informative controls for the prompt branch, but no component ablation, gpt-4o feedback vs an unstated DSPy teacher, unmatched budgets, voting vs single-sample baselines (opus:O05), and graph propagation is never isolated.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2; verified. The retained prompt is gated on validation and evaluated on separate test splits (opus:O04), but the broad central claim rests on per-input refinement with extra compute, a re-extracted 39-problem LeetCode set, metrics optimised directly (molecules) and five patients with in-context examples of unclear relation.

E.statistics.reason: Resolved to son55's 1 under the A2 ladder. The in-scope retained claim (prompt optimisation) is single-run on 100-example BBH tests (opus:O03) while ties and a 7-pp gap are interpreted; the only multi-seed result (LeetCode, 5 seeds, ±SD; opus:O02) belongs to per-input instance optimisation, which carries no retained change, and radiotherapy SDs are over five instances of the same per-input procedure. Repeated-run variance on an out-of-scope branch does not lift the main retained result to 2.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 1; verified. Calls per edge/iteration are stated and extra test-time compute acknowledged, but no token/dollar totals and no compute- or feedback-model-matched baselines.

reason: Complete pinned text; all eight items resolved; one rating dispute resolved.

resolutions.reason: C18's tactic — manufacture the missing substrate so a dominant recipe transfers unchanged — is what TextGrad does: heterogeneous artifacts (prompts, code, SMILES, plans) become text variables so the autograd/optimizer recipe (backward, step, batching, momentum) applies across all of them. son55's reframe_as_solvable_object (optimisation recast as backprop) is real but has no fitting sub-card and the reduction is explicitly an analogy, so it is kept as supporting.

Both identifications describe different operations of the same method; keep unify/C18 primary, reframe and self_supervised_signal_engineering (LLM-generated critique as the adaptation signal) as the two supporting cards.

H09 is the framework claim (propagate feedback through a compound system), but no experiment optimises more than one interacting variable through the graph; the evidenced retained case is a single system prompt rewritten from per-example critiques under a validation gate, which is H10. Both recorded with fits H09 partial, H10 strong.

resolutions.final_value: final local-1 = sol's cost check (partial); son55-1 (DSPy teacher/budget mismatch) → final local-4 unmet
resolutions.reason: Same ID, different questions. sol-1: cost disclosure (calls per edge/iteration stated, totals missing → partial). son55-1: DSPy baseline uses an unstated teacher and different call counts (verified: §3.3 states only 10 candidates/8 demos) → unmet. Both kept.

resolutions.final_value: final local-2 = sol's in-silico measurement check (partial); son55-2 (statistics) merged into final local-3 unmet
resolutions.reason: Different questions. sol-2 (molecule/plan metrics are in-silico proxies; partial) kept; son55-2 is the same statistics question as sol-3 and is merged there.

resolutions.reason: Statistics: for the retained prompt claim there are no seeds or intervals (opus:O03), so unmet (son55's status for the same question); sol's 'partial' leaned on LeetCode seeds from the instance branch. son55-3 verified (opus:O01) and kept as a measurement check.
SOTA-type claims rest on voting-based test-time compute (opus:O05), a re-extracted 39-problem set and directly optimised in-silico metrics; renumbered to local-6 because final local-4 holds son55-1.
The reduction to backprop is an explicit analogy; no equivalence or guarantee.
Graph/variable/optimizer abstractions repackage critique-and-rewrite; gain over single-critique rewriting untested.
No test that propagated critiques localise to the responsible variable (sol's worked example even shows credit drift).
No ablation of critique feedback vs random/naive edits, momentum or batching.
Calls per iteration stated; no totals or comparison with baselines.
Primary card adopted: DSPy/Reflexion/CoT controls exist but no same-information naive critic or route-removal control.
Breadth across code/QA/prompt/molecule/plan, but one critic family and in-silico science metrics.
Task metrics are direct; the foregrounded 'gradient/credit assignment' concept is never measured directly.
Prompt branch uses labels; instance QA uses self-evaluation; Word Sorting judged by the feedback-model family.
Critiques on the prompt are not checked for whether the failure was caused by the prompt (failure mode present).
Certification on held-out test for prompts only; other branches not separated.
Held-out test and an alternative optimiser reported; teacher models differ and budgets unmatched.

Attribution scope is built into the design (per-edge routing with role/neighbour context) but its correctness is untested; 'partial' describes a present-but-unverified condition better than 'unknown'.
The backward engine sees the full forward conversation, objective and variable roles.

Repeated-run variance on an out-of-scope branch does not lift the main retained result to 2.
